category_title: Adolescents who disengage due to perceived teacher indifference and lack of individual support
minimal_context: The student is attempting to complete a worksheet passed out in the last fifteen minutes of class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, we have fifteen minutes left in class. I'm passing out the work now, please get started on it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying to do it, but I don't understand. Can I get some help?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just review what we just went over. Give it a try.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You just went on and on talking for the whole period. I still don't get what to do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I've already helped you once. I can't help you more than that right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You didn't help me with anything, so I just stopped doing my work.
